author: potuz
content: I haven't tracked why exactly, but every time that Nethermind restarts, it triggers a bug in Prysm that prevents it from catching up and keeps it a few slots behind when there are blobs. Other ELs don't do this (or at least I haven't noticed it) so I'm curious why this happens on EL restart only on Nethermind. Anyway I think I have a simple fix for the issue on Prysm's side, but it's tricky to test cause I don't know the trigger, just that it happens on Nethermind's restarts and not even sure if it happens always.
